question: Find the value of [(23 times 5) timesleft{6 div 6 times ((18-14))/(4)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: [(23 times 5) timesleft{6 div 6 times ((18-14))/(4)right}]

**Formula Used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS/BIDMAS): Brackets, Orders (i.e. powers and square roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction

**Calculation:**

[(23 times 5) timesleft{6 div 6 times ((18-14))/(4)right}]

⇒ **[(115) timesleft{6 div 6 times ((4))/(4)right}]**

⇒ **[(115) timesleft{6 div 6 times 1right}]**

⇒ 1

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
